notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
